statements.action_statement: No fixed release is available yet; update when Docker Hardened Images publishes one.
statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-8262: in Yarn 1.x up to 1.22.22, explodeHostedGitFragment() in src/resolvers/exotics/hosted-git-resolver.js strips the hash and protocol from a hosted Git dependency with the regular expressions /(.*?)#.*/ and /.*:(.*)/, which take super-linear time on a crafted dependency specifier (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-8262). Yarn 1.x is no longer maintained and has no fixed release; the fix proposed upstream in https://github.com/yarnpkg/yarn/pull/9199 (commit https://github.com/yarnpkg/yarn/commit/97731871e674bf93bcbf29e9d3258da8685f3076) replaces both expressions with string splits, and has not been merged. Checked the bundled lib/cli.js in both DHI yarn packages published for Alpine 3.23, 1.22.22-r1 and 1.22.22_git20260211-r2 (noarch, identical on x86_64 and aarch64): both still contain the two vulnerable expressions in explodeHostedGitFragment and not the proposed fix. No published build carries the change from pull request 9199, so every published build is affected.
